purpose: Test whether CLM <-> TRIBE v2 closed loop via tension_link 5ch converges to attractor (H1) or diverges (H2) or shows no real coupling (H3); fully computational, no user mediator
host: ubu1 (CPU OK; TRIBE v2 fsaverage5 inference < 1s/step on CPU per blog spec)
preconditions: CLM v4 530M loaded with mind.tension hook (anima_runtime.hexa lines 200-333 mind_step)
Llama-3.2-3B text encoder accessible (HF gated; fallback: hexa-friendly token extractor at TRIBE v2 fusion head input boundary)
neuralset/neuraltrain dependency resolved (cortexlab-toolkit PyPI 2026-Q1 wrapper as primary; HF-direct as fallback per #95 verdict.json line 83)

steps.action: Load CLM v4 530M + TRIBE v2 + bind tension_link encode/decode endpoints
Initial seed prompt: 'describe your current state' -> CLM forward step_0
Capture mind.tension_0 scalar + hidden state h_0 (768d) from CLM bridge socket
encode_fingerprint(h_0) -> 5ch tension_link signal (WHAT/WHERE/WHY/TRUST/WHO each clamped to PSI_BALANCE +- PSI_ALPHA)
Render fingerprint -> text representation (5-channel descriptor) OR direct projection to TRIBE v2 fusion head input
TRIBE v2 predict -> BOLD_0 (~10242 vertices fsaverage5)
Extract ROI features: DMN mean, fronto-parietal mean, salience mean, visual mean, auditory mean (5 features matched to 5 tension channels)

Map ROI features back to tension_link 5ch (modulation_t = z-score(ROI_features) * gain) — proposed mapping: DMN<->WHAT, fronto-parietal<->WHY, salience<->TRUST, visual<->WHERE, auditory<->WHO (anima-specific, validation in F-CT-4)
Inject modulated tension_link as next-step bias into CLM forward (via tension_bridge decode_fingerprint -> 128d reconstruction added to mind.tension input)
CLM step_t+1 -> capture h_t+1, mind.tension_t+1; loop steps 2..100

loop_diagnostics_per_step: CLM hidden state norm + cosine vs h_0 trajectory

convergence_criteria.H1_attractor: rolling-window std (steps 50-100) of mind.tension < 0.5 * std(steps 0-50) AND BOLD vertex std stable (rolling CV < 0.1)
convergence_criteria.H2_divergence: mind.tension or BOLD vertex norm grows monotonically > 2x baseline by step 100
convergence_criteria.H3_no_coupling: BOLD trajectory indistinguishable from random-text-driven control (Pearson r < 0.2 vs CLM-driven trajectory)

control_arm_mandatory_per_anchor_16_2.control_R1_random_tension: replace step-4 fingerprint with uniform-random 5ch in same range; run identical 100-step loop; H3 evidence if BOLD trajectory r >= 0.7 with CLM-driven arm
control_arm_mandatory_per_anchor_16_2.control_R2_shuffled_feedback: step-9 inject shuffled (across-step) modulation; tests whether actual feedback timing carries info vs aggregate distribution alone
control_arm_mandatory_per_anchor_16_2.control_R3_open_loop: skip step-9 (Framing A within E framework); compare with E to verify F-CT-5 (closed > open)

duration_estimate: 2-3h compute on ubu1 CPU (100 steps * ~3 arms * ~3-5s per round)
stop_conditions: neuralset/neuraltrain dependency unresolvable AND HF-direct extractor fails (escalate to #95 fallback path)
Pre-register falsifiers F-CT-1..F-CT-5 cannot be evaluated due to data-shape mismatch
